recordingAssessment.observations: The 0s frame is initial white content; 2s shows the economics shell; 4s shows visible focus on the room trend disclosure; 6s/8s show operation investigation; 10s shows history navigation; 12s/14s show mobile allowance fields and review; 16s shows configuration; 18s shows the mobile comparison; 20s shows a focused expanded daily-quality table; 22s shows return to economics controls. recordingAssessment.limits: Sampling supports state/continuity inspection but cannot establish every transition, absence of short flashes, continuous playback quality, actual timing performance, or human-paced usability.

dimensions.observation: Quality remains a bounded card after common filters and view controls. Four capability cards precede the new Quality over time section, whose four closed disclosures avoid rendering four full tables at once. Expanded reconstruction content stays within the same card; mobile stacks the cards and preserves investigation below the trend.

Does the spending produce useful results? introduces summary rates, then Quality over time explicitly invites capability expansion. The reconstruction label names UTC request day, and explanatory cohort/coverage text comes before the chart/table. The repeated page introduction and tall mobile station remain inherited debt.

Warm serif section headings and gold rate figures distinguish outcomes from muted exact denominators. Focused desktop rows read 10.0% with 2/20 and 33.3% with 10/30; cost columns read $1.28/$0.64 and $1.92/$0.192. Mobile trend text is readable at original width. Dense 11px date/coverage labels and pre-existing long fractional means warrant preserving the existing readability debt.

The trend instruction, disclosure title, explanatory paragraph, plot, sample/scroll cue and table have separate vertical intervals. Mobile disclosure titles wrap to two lines without collisions; the focused table outline remains contained. Opening the trend increases document length but does not overlap the next capability or investigation block.

Existing Quality & Outcomes navigation leads to visibly labeled per-capability disclosure controls. The reconstruction disclosure opens via Enter on desktop and click at mobile width; source uses native details/summary and a named table region. Common filters and existing operation/People controls remain visible. The three other trend disclosures were visible closed; their expanded visual variants are not separately captured.

Gold sample dots and disclosure labels stand apart from dark green surfaces, pale body text and muted column labels remain readable, and aqua focus outlines are conspicuous on desktop/mobile controls. The inspected browser test asserts no serious/critical axe findings inside the economics workspace in the expanded mobile state; neither this nor visual inspection certifies every ratio or shared-shell chrome.

The increment reuses the Admiralty card, gold accent, native disclosure, common filters and contained table treatment. Capability names and acceptance versus Apply distinctions agree with the registry. Current reconstruction profile remains Sol in the legacy-policy fixture while historical room operations remain Luna, preserving current-policy/history separation.

Populated reconstruction shows two recorded dates and exact rows. Empty January shows Unavailable rates and No dated operations in this period rather than invented zero trends. Loading identifies a pending refresh; failure names the retained January period and unapplied October filters; retry returns to the populated expanded trend. Unknown-only/undated and retry partial-cost branches are verified by source and reviewer-run tests, not separate rendered captures.

At mobile width, common filters and tabs wrap, quality cards stack, and the trend plot/date labels fit the card. The daily table contains horizontal overflow: its initial position shows UTC day, operations and rate; the ArrowRight capture shows accepted rooms, observed cost/coverage and cost per useful result. This establishes access across all six columns without page-wide expansion. Separate allowance tables still have the inherited cue/readability debt.

Actual Enter opens/closes the reconstruction disclosure after the test establishes focus. Actual repeated ArrowRight input produces positive contained-table scrollLeft and brings Cost per useful result into the mobile viewport. Exact rows remain available beyond the SVG. A full Tab-from-entry journey, screen reader operation and every policy-table keyboard position are not demonstrated.

The focused Quality button has an aqua outline, the daily fallback disclosure has a visible outline, and the mobile quality table keeps a strong outline after horizontal keyboard scrolling. The 4s sampled frame shows focus on the closed room trend summary. Focus-target captures center the active control below sticky shell chrome; complete shell focus behavior is not certified.

Opening the disclosure reveals its definition, separate samples and exact counts with no ambiguous interpolated curve. Loading economics changes the apply control, error explicitly identifies last successful data and unapplied changes, and retry clears the alert. Existing allowance application displays revision 1 and an audit receipt; that remains governed policy feedback rather than an outcome acceptance signal.

The new trend is a static dot plot and native disclosure, without chart animation or interpolated motion. The inspected test applies reducedMotion: reduce before mobile captures. Sampled frames show meaningful control/state changes without player overlays, but no continuous playback or actual transition-timing acceptance is claimed.

The complete recorded/tested route starts at /admin, enters AI Usage & Quotas, opens quality/trend, follows investigation to history and an operation inspector, enters canonical People allowance controls, inspects capabilities/configuration, and returns. Recovery retains the selected Quality view and expanded trend. Existing registry complete People-search and daily-metric journeys remain separate protected obligations.

Per-capability disclosures progressively reveal the newly dense chart and six-column exact table. The visible scroll cue explains access to hidden columns, and nearby text explains cohort timing, room deduplication, incomplete coverage and missing dates. The mobile page remains long, with rates preceding the trend and canonical dossier controls; this is retained hierarchy debt rather than an unreported shortcut.

The authenticated Administrator can compare request-day reconstruction rates of 2/20 and 10/30 and observed cost per accepted room of $0.64 and $0.192. Exact rows distinguish successful operations from deduplicated accepted rooms. Source/reviewer tests separately preserve Assistant Apply semantics, all observed unsuccessful cost, current-state undo semantics, unknown outcome exclusion and per-day versus full-range deduplication. These are descriptive synthetic observations, not causation, production invoice proof or owner acceptance.

The exact focusable daily table supplies values/denominators beyond chart perception. Empty dates do not create zero samples; empty denominators and unknown-only evidence produce null/Unavailable; undated history is explicitly counted and excluded. Other AI Operations has no registered useful semantics and therefore cannot acquire a false success rate/cost-per-useful-result. All non-room expanded variants and populated unknown-only UI branches are source/test-supported and remain outside the captured rendered variants.

utcRequestDay.observation: Filters select createdAt initiation time [from,to), daily grouping uses recorded utcDay, and UI consistently names UTC request-day cohorts. Later canonical acceptance/Apply updates the originating cohort. Browser fixture uses October 12/14; the fixed unit-test clock yields October 11/13, so differing fixture dates are expected and not relabeled as one dataset.

rateAndDedup.observation: Rate numerator counts accepted/accepted-then-edited reconstruction operations, or currently APPLIED Assistant operations. Denominator excludes UNKNOWN outcomes. Distinct room results deduplicate accountId+acceptedResourceId within each day, and separately across the selected range; daily room totals need not sum to the range total. The reviewer-run test covers the same room on one and multiple days.

costAndSample.observation: Cost per useful result divides all observed capability cost, including unsuccessful work, by useful results, and stays unavailable without a useful denominator or a fully costed operation. Daily coverage counts fully costed SETTLED/RELEASED operations, preserving partial known retry cost without calling the whole operation fully costed. Table exposes cost coverage. Small-sample flags explicitly use total operations below 10; they are descriptive warnings rather than statistical confidence. Exact classified denominators and unavailable counts remain visible for rate interpretation.

chartSemantics.observation: Rates are separate observed dots on a stated 0-100% scale, positioned by elapsed UTC date. Missing dates are not zero-filled and no line implies intermediate quality. Start/end dates are visible; the exact table is the definitive source for each date and denominator. Room reconstruction is the actual expanded visual cohort; other capabilities share the component but have no separate expanded capture.
